narrow_inference.title: A100 · TriangleAttention (starting node) · inference · fused path: d_pair 64 / 128, 2 or 4 heads of 16 / 32, bf16, L = 128k

panels.label: forward (nothing saved)

kernels.name: weight pack
code: W' = bf16(cat(W_q, W_k, W_v, W_g, W_b) · γ)   # rows in the kernel's order
b  = cat(W_q, ..., W_b) @ β                   # fp32

kernels.name: LN + q|k|v|g + bias
code: xh = (x - mean) · rstd              # statistics in registers
qkvg = xh @ W'.T + b                # one pass, weights resident in smem
bias = (xh @ W'_b.T + b_b).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
bias = bias.masked_fill(~mask[:, None, None], min)

kernels.name: attention
code: s = q[h] @ k[h].T / sqrt(hd) + bias[h]
o[h] = softmax(s, -1) @ v[h]
# per pair row i, head h; online softmax, hd = 16 kept as it is (no padding)

kernels.name: gate + out proj + residual
code: a = sigmoid(g) · o
y = x + a @ W_o.T

narrow_training.title: A100 · TriangleAttention (starting node) · training · fused path: d_pair 64 / 128, 2 or 4 heads of 16 / 32, bf16, broadcast dropout, L = 128k

panels.label: forward (saves xh1, mean / rstd, qkvg, bias, o, lse, ds)

kernels.name: LN + q|k|v|g + bias (saving)
code: xh, (mean, rstd) = LN statistics in registers
qkvg = xh @ W'.T + b;  bias = ... masked
xh1 = [xh | 1 | 0]                 # the weight-gradient operand

kernels.name: attention + LSE
code: s = q[h] @ k[h].T / sqrt(hd) + bias[h]
o[h] = softmax(s, -1) @ v[h]
lse = logsumexp(s)   # base 2, per (h, i, j)

kernels.name: gate + out proj + dropout + residual
code: a = sigmoid(g) · o
y = x + (a @ W_o.T) · ds

panels.hbm_title: HBM (sizes at L = 768, d_pair 64, 4 heads x 16)

panels.label: backward; D = [dq | dk | dv | dg], one buffer, each slice written by its producer

kernels.name: backward weight pack
code: W_t = W_*ᵀ  (the dgrad operands), W_oᵀ, γ in fp32

kernels.name: gate + out-proj backward
code: dy = dout · ds;   da = dy @ W_o
do = da · sigmoid(g);   dg = da · o · s · (1 - s)
a = sigmoid(g) · o;     Δ = Σ_d o · do   # per head

kernels.name: bias transpose
code: bias_t[h, k, j] = bias[h, j, k]

kernels.name: attention backward, key side
code: P^T = exp2(scale · k q^T + bias_t - lse);  dS^T = P^T (v do^T - Δ)
dv = P^T do;   dk = sm_scale · dS^T q
# per pair row i, head h, 128-key tile

kernels.name: attention backward, query side
code: P = exp2(scale · q k^T + bias - lse);  dS = P (do v^T - Δ)
dq = sm_scale · dS @ k
db[h, j, k] = Σ_i dS_i   # R = 4 rows per CTA, then a fixed-order reduce

kernels.name: projection dgrad + LN backward + residual
code: dxn = D @ W_cat + db-term
dx = rstd (dxn γ - mean(dxn γ) - xh mean(dxn γ xh))
dx_pair = dout + dx

kernels.name: weight and LN-parameter gradients
code: G = Dᵀ @ xh1;  G_b = dbᵀ @ xh1     # K = L²
dW = G γ + G[:, D] βᵀ;  dγ = Σ_o W ⊙ G;  dβ = Σ_o W s
dW_o = dyᵀ @ a

rows_inference.title: A100 · TriangleAttention (starting node) · inference · row-kernel path: d_pair 256 / 384 / 512, 8 / 12 / 16 heads x 32, bf16, L = 128k

panels.label: forward (nothing saved)

kernels.name: weight pack
code: W'_aug = [bf16(W · γ) | b_hi | b_lo | 0]    # b = W β split into two bf16
# rows: q | k | v | g (head h, channel c), then the bias heads (padded to 8)

kernels.name: LayerNorm rows
code: xh = (x - mean) · rstd                       # fp32 statistics
xh_aug = [xh | 1 | 1 | 0 ...]               # the constant columns carry b_hi, b_lo

kernels.name: projections
code: y = xh_aug @ W'_aug.T      # q | k | v | g | bias heads, one GEMM

kernels.name: bias planes
code: bias[h, i, j] = y[(i, j), bias head h]  masked to min  # head planes [H, L, L]

kernels.name: attention + gate
code: s = q[h] @ k[h].T / sqrt(hd) + bias[h]
o[h] = softmax(s, -1) @ v[h]
a = bf16(sigmoid(g) · o)         # the epilogue
reads: q, k, v, g (columns of y)

kernels.name: output projection
code: yo = a @ W_o.T

kernels.name: dropout + residual
code: out = x + yo · ds        # the ending node: transposed positions

rows_training.title: A100 · TriangleAttention (starting node) · training · row-kernel path: d_pair 256 / 384 / 512, 8 / 12 / 16 heads x 32, bf16, broadcast dropout, L = 128k

panels.label: forward (saves xh_aug, mean / rstd, y, bias, o, lse)

kernels.name: pack, LayerNorm rows, projections, bias planes
code: xh_aug, (mean, rstd) = LN(x)           # + constant columns
y = xh_aug @ W'_aug.T                  # q | k | v | g | bias heads
bias = planes of y's bias columns, masked

kernels.name: attention + gate + LSE
code: o[h] = softmax(q[h] @ k[h].T / sqrt(hd) + bias[h], -1) @ v[h];  lse (base 2)
a = bf16(sigmoid(g) · o)
reads: q, k, v, g (columns of y)

kernels.name: output projection + dropout + residual
code: yo = a @ W_o.T;  out = x + yo · ds

panels.hbm_title: HBM (sizes at L = 768, d_pair 256, 8 heads x 32)

panels.label: backward; D = [dq | dk | dv | dg], one buffer, each slice written by its producer

kernels.name: dy (dropout, transposed positions)
code: dy = dout · ds    # in the starting frame

kernels.name: out-proj dgrad, gate backward
code: da = dy @ W_o                          # cuBLAS
do = da · sigmoid(g);  dg = da · o · s · (1 - s)
a = sigmoid(g) · o;    Δ = Σ_d o · do   # per head

kernels.name: attention backward (bias transpose, key side, query side + db reduce)
code: dS = P (do v^T - Δ);  dq = sm_scale · dS @ k;  dk = sm_scale · dS^T q;  dv = P^T do
db[h, j, k] = Σ_i dS_i   # bf16 partials of 4 rows, a fixed-order reduce

kernels.name: projection dgrad + LayerNorm backward
code: dxn = D @ W_cat                        # cuBLAS, K = 4 H hd
dx = rstd (dxn γ - mean(dxn γ) - xh mean(dxn γ xh)) + db-term + dout

kernels.name: weight and LN-parameter gradients
code: G = Dᵀ @ xh_aug;  G_b = dbᵀ @ xh_aug     # K = L²
dW = G γ + G[:, D] βᵀ;  dγ, dβ;  dW_o = dyᵀ @ a

kernels.name: attention
code: s = q[a, h] @ k[a, h].T / sqrt(hd) + bias[h]       # a = pair row, the bias is shared by the rows
s = -inf where ~mask[a, :]                         # a key tile without a masked key skips this
out[a, h] = softmax(s, -1) @ v[a, h]               # operands read in place through their strides

kernels.name: bias transpose

dv = P^T do;   dk = sm_scale · dS^T q

kernels.name: attention backward, query side
